rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_ihd_incidence(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	target1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
  result1 int(7) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)

) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_ihd_incidence WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ihd_incidence','target1','int(7) DEFAULT 0 ');
CALL AddCol('hdc','s_ihd_incidence','result1','int(7) DEFAULT 0 ');


INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ihd_incidence 
( id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target,result )
SELECT
	 @id,v.hospcode,v.villcode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year,IFNULL(p.total,0) as pop
	,IFNULL(t.v,0)
FROM
cvillage_hosp v
LEFT JOIN
	(	SELECT villcode,SUM(total) total 
		FROM cmidyearpop 
		WHERE (SUBSTR(yearmonth,1,4)-543) = @b_year	AND SUBSTR(villcode,1,2) = @prov_c 	
		GROUP BY villcode 
	) as p  ON  v.villcode=p.villcode

LEFT JOIN
	(SELECT
	t.d_hospcode,t.d_pt_vhid
	,SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(SUBSTR(date_dx,1,10),'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN concat(@b_year-1,'1001') AND concat(@b_year,'0931')  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) v
	FROM
	(  SELECT *	FROM
		(	SELECT d.* FROM t_chronic d
			WHERE  (substr(d.diagcode,1,3)  BETWEEN 'I21' AND 'I24'	 OR d.diagcode in('I200'))
				AND d.typedisch not in(1,2,7) AND d.nation=99 AND d.d_typearea in(1,3)
			ORDER BY cid,date_dx
		) as t
	  GROUP BY cid
	) as t 
	GROUP BY  t.d_hospcode,t.d_pt_vhid
	) as t ON v.villcode=t.d_pt_vhid
WHERE  (p.total >0 or t.v >0)
GROUP BY v.hospcode,v.villcode
ORDER BY villcode;

UPDATE s_ihd_incidence s INNER JOIN s_ihd_incidence s1 ON s.hospcode=s1.hospcode AND s.areacode=s1.areacode 
SET s.target1=s1.target,s.result1=s1.result
WHERE s.b_year=(@b_year+543) AND s1.b_year=(@b_year+542);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_ihd_incidence ( id,hospcode,areacode,flag_sent,date_com,b_year,target1,result1 )
SELECT  id,hospcode,areacode,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year
	,target,result
FROM  s_ihd_incidence 
WHERE b_year=(@b_year+542);

zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target1") "target1" ,SUM("result1") "result1" ,SUM("target") target2 ,SUM("result") result2  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
